description: Following approval for refurbishment, replacement and development of buildings and associated circulation, parking and landscaping for educational and ancillary residential use amended plans submitted including: revised layout to lower ground level parking, cycle and refuse storage of proposed staff accommodation.  Removal of proposed link between Block A and 80 Lonsdale Road.  Angling of first floor level corner of Block B next to 1 Lillian Road.  Addition of flue to Block B.  Sectional drawings to address potential overlooking from terrace of Block A.  Submission of additional information regarding contaminated land as part of Environmental Statement.  Revised Tree Report and addendum report to daylight and sunlight report.  Submission of Refuse Management Strategy and signed EcoHomes assessment.  Additional supporting information regarding equal opportunities, opportunities from disadvantaged backgrounds, and Employment, Training and Community Use Strategy.
